components.text: Three current models compared for software development work

**Go with the MacBook Pro 14 (M4 Pro)** if your stack is macOS, iOS or cross-platform: it has the best performance-per-watt, the longest battery life and a very high-resolution display.

Choose the **ThinkPad X1 Carbon** instead if you live in a terminal on Linux or travel light — it is the lightest here and has the best keyboard, at the cost of a dimmer, lower-resolution screen.

The **Dell XPS 14** is the value pick: the OLED panel is the nicest of the three, but 16 GB of RAM is the weak spot for heavy builds and containers.
